name: What finishes make a small ADU kitchen look bigger?

mainEntity.name: Which design choices help an ADU kitchen feel larger and brighter in a compact space?
mainEntity.text: Which design choices help an ADU kitchen feel larger and brighter in a compact space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small ADU kitchen can feel much larger when the finishes are coordinated and the visual lines stay clean. Light cabinet colors, pale countertops, and a simple backsplash help reflect more light, especially in units with limited windows. Under-cabinet lighting is also valuable because it brightens the work area without adding visual clutter. Flat-panel or minimally detailed cabinetry often works well in small kitchens because it avoids busy shadow lines. Matching appliance finishes and limiting too many competing materials can also make the room feel calmer and more spacious. Another important factor is the cabinet-to-ceiling treatment. In some cases, extending cabinetry upward can reduce visual breaks and increase storage, but only if the proportions stay balanced. The best effect usually comes from a kitchen that looks intentionally simple rather than sparsely furnished. In ADU construction, a larger feeling often comes from restraint in the design, not from adding more elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light-colored cabinets, reflective surfaces, simple hardware, good lighting, and a continuous backsplash can make a small ADU kitchen feel larger. Avoiding visual clutter and using cohesive finishes helps the room read as open rather than chopped up. Layout matters as much as color.
